subject: Important Update on Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for applying for the [Job Title] position at [Company Name]. We are currently in the process of reviewing all applications and expect to reach a decision by the end of this week. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and will keep you updated on the status of your application. Should you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to us. Best regards, [Company HR Team]
